workloadBearer.description: JWT is the default. Services can also accept opaque bearer tokens. An opaque peer credential must accompany a LASA-Workload-Identity header matching the authenticated caller and receiver. Both modes resolve callers through receiver-owned policy.

CallerTaskRequest.description: Authenticated users may set a delegation restriction for this task.

DelegationMode.description: none bars peer tasks; policy permits only delegation authorized by receiver policy.
